name: Chaos Code Nemesis Experiment
storyline:
In the previous struggle for the hidden power—the turmoil known as the "Research Institute Incident"—neither the Earth Federation Government Army to which Oda Itsuki Hikaru belonged, nor the Kurenai Shu with Kagari, nor any other faction were able to obtain the "CHAOS CODE."

The seemingly limitless energy source, "Chaotix," has now become the backbone of all the world's infrastructure. Dr. Tesla, who developed "Chaotix" and disappeared after leaving behind the words "CHAOS CODE," was discovered by his own android, Celia, during the laboratory incident, but the mystery surrounding him remains unsolved.

And now, the Earth Federation Government forces, seeing "CHAOS CODE" as something that could amplify the power of "Chaotix" and transform it into the foundation of domination and order, have begun to put their forbidden plan into motion.

The NEMESIS Project—and the “NEMESIS Experiment” unfolding in its depths. Those who seek to seize control of chaos will once again be swallowed up by the spiral of fate.
summary: A brand new fighting game for arcades, " Chaos Code Nemesis Experiment ," is coming to arcades nationwide from FK Digital and exA-Arcadia! This title is the latest installment in the popular fighting game series "Chaos Code." With widescreen support, battles are more dynamic and fast-paced, and the series' signature systems such as "Skill Select" and "Dash Select" remain intact. Even with the same character, different fighting styles are possible depending on the selection, allowing for a wider variety of tactics. Furthermore, a new gauge system, "NEX Gauge," has been introduced in this game, further deepening the strategic depth. And of course, the series' other charm, the unique characters, are also present. Many unique members will be joining the fight, including the otaku protagonist "Hikaru," the chef "Bravo" who engages in cooking battles, and the cosplay-loving shojo manga artist "Catherine." In addition, a new character, the middle-aged transforming hero "Gou," will appear! With a comical yet passionate battle style, he will breathe new life into the world of fighting games. In addition, some existing characters will reappear with new visuals. All characters have had their voices newly recorded, making this a truly "completely new" game.
